criteria.description: Sticky shell, bar disclosure, and fullscreen overlay reach every documented state: desktop disclosure hover/click open-close, keyboard Enter/Space, Escape with focus return, outside/destination close, always-visible toggle open/close for overlay, mobile activation-only overlay, breakpoint close, JS-disabled usability

Exactly one brand, four desktop bar entries (3 plain + 1 disclosure), three title-only destinations, one named always-visible toggle, one chevron, eight large overlay destinations, contact form (name/email/message/terms/submit), phone+email+address details, five named socials — no duplicate chevrons or nested nav landmarks

Desktop sticky logo-left / centered bar menu / end toggle; mobile top row logo+toggle only; open overlay is full-viewport with large links then contact rail; no under-bar mobile tree for the four bar links
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
